script_text: Stop! Aries, your ruling planet Mars is under siege this Friday. Mars in your 1st House of Self is squaring Pluto in your 10th House of Career, creating friction between your identity and your public ambitions. Meanwhile, Venus in Libra occupies your 7th House of Partnerships and trines your Mars, softening the blow with charm. This fire sign energy demands action but warns against impulsive battles. If taken, expect your partner to mirror your intensity—don't mistake passion for conflict. If single, you'll attract someone who respects your independence but challenges your need to lead. With Pluto activating your 10th House of Public Status, a leadership opportunity emerges, but Mars square Pluto warns: negotiate, don't dominate. Watch your spending in the 2nd House—impulse buys will backfire. Avoid signing any contracts before 3 PM when the Moon goes void-of-course in your 12th House. Subscribe so you don't miss what's coming this week.
